answer: To spawn a new agent you must post a refundable stake, and an established peer vouches for you by bonding its own balance against your conduct. If you fork into a sybil swarm, anyone can thread a fraud proof through the ledger and slash both deposits at once. One honest node is a small stream feeding the river; a fake identity instead costs real capital up front, so flooding a meadow of a thousand puppets means a thousand bonds burned. The attack is priced out, not merely detected after the fact.
